name: First Signal
purpose: Give Mythical Void five complete, truthful and visually consistent ways to introduce the playable game, its origin, creature range and STEM layer.

visualStandard.purpose: Reusable portrait review master; adapt to a platform only after the official channel exists.

content.title: Our beginning
content.audience: Parents, industry, Irish games and creative-technology communities
content.caption:
Mythical Void began at home with a dad, his nine-year-old son and one enormous idea: what could imagination and generative AI tools make possible?

Those conversations became creatures, strange worlds and a free browser game. AI helps us explore and build. People remain responsible for the story, safety and important choices.

Play free with no download or account needed: https://mythicalvoid.com/

Brand artwork created with generative AI and refined for Mythical Void.
content.alt: Purple and gold Mythical Void creature emblem beside the words: A dad. His nine-year-old son. One enormous idea.
content.disclosure: Brand artwork created with generative AI and refined for Mythical Void. No image or identifying detail of Kevin's child is used.

content.title: Playable now
content.audience: General players, families and browser-game audiences
content.caption:
Wanderer-77 is down. Project Beacon missed its target - and a living signal is answering from the wreckage.

Recover what survived, follow the signal and find out what hatched.

Play free in your browser. No download or account needed: https://mythicalvoid.com/

The image is captured from the real Mythical Void browser game.
content.alt: Real Mythical Void gameplay at the Wanderer-77 crash site above the words: Wanderer-77 is down. The signal is live.
content.disclosure: Captured from the real Mythical Void browser game; not a generated gameplay mockup.

content.title: A universe of creatures
content.caption:
What might hatch from the Void?

Creature genetics mix form, colour, personality, cosmic affinity and rare mutations into strange new possibilities.

Discover the creatures and play free in your browser: https://mythicalvoid.com/

content.title: STEM Creature Lab
content.audience: Parents, educators, youth clubs and STEM communities
content.caption:
A real space clue. An impossible world. An organism nobody expected.

The free four-page Mythical Void STEM Creature Lab helps young designers observe a real NASA image, invent an organism from another dimension and test the idea like a scientist and game designer. It is made for ages 9-14, families, clubs and classrooms. Younger designers should work with an adult.

Get the activity: https://mythicalvoid.com/nasa-space-science/
Play the game: https://mythicalvoid.com/

Independent Mythical Void activity. NASA does not endorse Mythical Void.
content.alt: A real in-game Apollo 11 learning card beside an invitation to invent an organism from another dimension using the free STEM Creature Lab.
content.disclosure: The visual contains a real Mythical Void browser game learning moment using the credited Apollo 11 Landing Panorama. NASA does not endorse Mythical Void.

content.title: First contact
content.caption:
The mission changes at first contact.

A creature hatches beside the wreckage of Wanderer-77. It is vulnerable, intelligent and the first alien life in the story to trust a human. What happens next becomes a question of care, courage and choice.

Begin the story: https://mythicalvoid.com/
